description: Strip every vowel from your text (disemvoweling) and see exactly how many vowels were removed.

faqs.a: Disemvoweling removes all a, e, i, o, u letters (both cases) — a classic trick for spoiling text while keeping it barely readable.
Yes — the tool shows the vowel count and the number of characters removed.
faqs.q: Does it count the vowels it removed?

faqs.a: Accents are kept; only plain ASCII vowels a/e/i/o/u are stripped.
faqs.q: What about accented vowels like é or ü?

title: Remove Vowels Tool
